**Performance: pass** at `ef8cdd5f22b268a28aaabb2db6b9d587f4806566`.

Reviewed `09aa310..ef8cdd5`: docs, removal of the 15 approved exemptions from both data sources, and the actual-repo test's exact-count assertion. Sensor algorithms and gate wiring are unchanged. No new timer, poll, recurring task, daemon launch site, dependency or migration.

The added blueprint/workstream contribute **two more `.dd.json` reads/parses per coverage sweep**, plus their rows/links and s17 in an existing document. The same four directory listings remain; exemption/baseline comparison now has zero entries. Cost follows manual gate/document-reader invocations, not a new per-seat schedule. The existing standalone sweep plus actual-repo Vitest sweep in a full gate remains unchanged; #160's command-local scaling limits still apply.

Exact-head [CI 42399336669](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42399336669) succeeds; Node 22 executes **all 18 coverage tests**, including the real-repo case requiring no findings and exactly zero approved exemptions. Latest Delivers **42399336693** also succeeds at this SHA. The printed test duration is not an assembled-gate benchmark.

No local sensor, gate, build, test, probe or worktree edit. This cost pass does not replace reviewer/security document, coverage or privacy proof. No daemon after-deploy reading is needed for these changes.
